svg.title: Code management and CI/CD
svg.text: Code management and CI/CD: how the solution is built, shipped and rolled back
GitLab project devops-ai/pipeline-triage on gitlab-server · pipelines run on gitlab-runner · images in ai-nexus:5001 · deploy to Docker Desktop.
Chips show where each stage runs: MR pipelines run stages 1-6 (build without push), main adds 7, a release tag adds 8.
Any failing stage blocks the merge or release. Stage 6 also runs on a nightly schedule to catch model or prompt drift.
Deploy uses a protected runner and a protected tag only; the deploy job is the only job allowed to touch Docker Desktop.
Rollback = re-run the deploy job on the previous tag (images are immutable, compose pins versions).
as SVG; PDFs rebuilt in CI
